meta.title: {appName} — Family tree in Bangla & English
meta.description: Build your family tree in Bangla or English. No sign-up needed.

landing.tagline: Your family's story, in one place
landing.description: Start with the oldest ancestor you remember and add the family around them, in Bangla or English.
landing.comingSoon: Family trees arrive in the next update. You can already create your account.

errors.notFoundBody: The page you're looking for doesn't exist.

session.offlineBody: We'll try again as soon as you're back online.
session.errorBody: Something went wrong. Please try again.

guest.title: You're using {appName} as a guest
guest.body: Everything you add is saved, but only in this browser. Create a free account to keep it safe and use it on other devices.
guest.retention: Guest data that isn't used for a year may be deleted.
guest.haveAccount: Already have an account? Log in

auth.signUpSubtitle: Everything you've added so far stays with you.

auth.signedUp: Your account is ready. Your work is now safe.

inAppBrowser.title: Open in your browser to use Google
inAppBrowser.body: Google sign-in doesn't work inside this app's built-in browser. Copy the link and open it in Chrome or Safari, or continue with your email below.
inAppBrowser.stepsIos: Tap ••• or the share button, then choose “Open in Safari”.

settings.title: Settings
settings.guestNameHint: Create an account to add your name.
settings.guestAccount: You're using a guest account on this browser.

trees.title: My family trees
trees.emptyBody: Begin with the oldest person you remember, such as a grandfather. You can add everyone else from there.

person.nameHint: In Bangla or English. You can add the other later.

merge.conflict: These guest trees were already moved, or can't be moved any more.

deleteAccount.sectionBody: Deletes your account, every tree you own and their photos. Trees that others share with you stay with them.
deleteAccount.title: Delete your account?
deleteAccount.body: Your account and all your trees will be deleted for good. This can't be undone.
deleteAccount.emailLabel: Type your email address to confirm
deleteAccount.googleHint: Next, Google will ask you to confirm it's you.

deleteGuest.sectionBody: Delete everything you made as a guest in this browser.

deleteGuest.done: Your guest data has been deleted.
